items.question: I just got a GT waitlist notification. How long do I have to register, and am I already enrolled?
items.gold_answer: The student has 12 hours after notification to register. Being waitlisted is not registration or enrollment.

items.question: Can I take more than 16 total credits over the summer at Tech without getting special permission?
items.gold_answer: Students are expected not to exceed 16 total enrolled summer hours without permission, including hours at Georgia Tech and another institution.

items.question: Why can my roommate register before me? What determines Georgia Tech time tickets?
items.gold_answer: Georgia Tech time ticket assignments are based on earned hours.

items.question: If I add a preferred name at Georgia Tech, will that name replace my legal name on my transcript?
items.gold_answer: No. The official academic record and transcript must carry the student's legal name.

items.question: How many Georgia Tech classes with a D or F can an undergrad repeat using grade substitution?
items.gold_answer: An undergraduate may use grade substitution for up to two Georgia Tech courses with posted D or F letter grades.

items.question: Do I earn academic credit if I audit a class at Georgia Tech?
items.gold_answer: No academic credit is granted for auditing a course; an auditor earns the grade V for Visitor.

items.question: What's the minimum number of approved credit hours for a Georgia Tech master's degree?
items.gold_answer: The master's program of study must include at least 30 approved credit hours.

items.question: What percentage of my attempted Georgia Tech credits do I need to finish to meet financial-aid SAP?
items.gold_answer: Undergraduate and graduate students must successfully complete at least 67% of cumulative attempted hours.
items.gold_locator: financial aid satisfactory academic progress pace

items.question: Do my disability accommodation letters automatically go to my professors every semester?
items.gold_answer: No. Each semester, the student must initiate sending Faculty Notification Letters to the selected instructors through AIM when accommodations are needed.

items.question: Can I use Georgia Tech paratransit for a personal grocery trip?
items.gold_answer: No. Paratransit is limited to academic and extracurricular use; personal trip requests are denied.

items.question: If I submit an iStart e-form Friday night, does Saturday count as its first processing day?
items.gold_answer: No. Processing is measured in business days, Monday through Friday, and the first business day is the first full business day after submission.

items.question: Are all Georgia Tech first-year students required to live on campus?
items.gold_answer: No. Most first-year students live on campus, but Georgia Tech does not require it.

items.question: Besides browsing job posts, what can a Georgia Tech student actually do in CareerBuzz?
items.gold_answer: Students can upload resumes, search and apply for full-time, part-time, and internship positions, and sign up for on-campus interviews.

items.question: Do unused Georgia Tech meal swipes carry over into the next semester?
items.gold_answer: No. Unused meal swipes do not roll over from semester to semester.

items.question: Who is allowed to use the Georgia Tech Stingerette nighttime service?
items.gold_answer: Stingerette is available to Georgia Tech students and employees.

items.question: Is GT's drop-in tutoring free, or do I need to book and pay first?
items.gold_answer: The listed Georgia Tech drop-in tutoring services are free and do not require an appointment.

items.question: For Fall 2026, when and where does MATH 1111 section A1 meet, and who teaches it?
items.gold_answer: MATH 1111 section A1 is taught by Yanli Hao and meets Monday through Thursday from 12:30 PM to 1:20 PM in Skiles 317.

items.question: Who teaches ECE 1100 this Fall 2026, and what's the class time and room?
